justification: Both surfaces share the same relief conventions for the human body — a profile figure with a heavy bare forearm ringed by a bracelet, hand reaching out toward the other element — and both use dense stylized scale/curl patterning as infill (fleece in A, wing plumage in B), which is a fairly specific shared repertoire. The subjects themselves diverge, however: A shows a pair of naturalistic horned rams being driven or led, while B shows a bearded winged figure with a stylized palmette plant and a crouching quadruped, so the scenes as wholes are different.
